data_source: approved_market_data_manifest.csv daily OHLCV + official TradeSim SET50 benchmark history

preregistered_parameters.benchmark: official TradeSim SET50 daily index close; source timestamp is session date
preregistered_parameters.portfolio_design_preregistered: top 3 equal weight; 5-session selection cadence; retain unchanged holdings while thesis remains valid; exit on thesis invalidation; no fixed maximum hold

cost_decomposition.slippage_treatment: already reflected in gross_return; reported separately for attribution

fifo_symbol_concentration.basis: FIFO realized net PnL for fully/partially closed lots; open-lot mark-to-market excluded

gate.rule: >=100 events, >=10 symbols, positive mean at 3 of 5 horizons; independent evidence remains subject to temporal/symbol dependence

limitations: Signal statistics are not executable PnL.
Events overlap in time and by symbol; approximate normal confidence intervals do not adjust for dependence.
No historical BBO, spread, or depth is used.
The benchmark series is official TradeSim history and has no fabricated rows.
